name: vidika-server
description: Serves the built site and takes the contact form. See README.md.
//: Declares one optional dependency and nothing else. The Resend transport runs on fetch, so the default path installs nothing and the runtime image carries no node_modules — nodemailer is pulled in only by MAIL_TRANSPORT=smtp, with `npm ci` here and the commented lines in the Dockerfile. Scripts live in the root package.json: `npm run serve` runs this, `npm run smoke` exercises it.
